positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer (Grade 12, Tech Lead 2)
Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- UI Developer (Front-End)
- Building a cloud email marketing platform
- Implementing the core application frameworks and reusable front-end modules
- Optimizing codes to make an application load faster
- Using ExtJS 6.0 framework
- Using Git to maintain the version control

positions.title: Side Project
positions.description:
Clocls (Cloud Class) - Online Language Education Platform
Everyone can be a teacher and teach their languages in real time.

- Implemented most UI components in ReactJS
- Used WebRTC framework (Licode)
- Web Socket (Socket.IO)

positions.title: Advance Design Engineer
positions.description:
Intel FPGA (Altera)
- Analyzed big raw data and implementing a dashboard, enabling team transparency and enabling any engineer to investigate the quality of the netlist with high capacity IT Data engine, Satin and Splunk
- Created the netlist build dashboard(JavaScript, CSS and PHP), a web-based method for interacting with the netlist build process
- Created a structured, deterministic, automated build process where none existed before
- Developed an automation tool with Python for high quality IP releases
- Developing full disaster recovery procedures and a process that can be robust when LSF farm is unstable
- Tracking all build errors and managing all IP releasing process for Altera 28nm devices, Stratix and Cyclone 5

positions.title: Individual Research with Dr. Robbert van Renesse
positions.description:
- Improved Bosco Protocol (One-Step Byzantine Asynchronous Consensus)
- Architected Consensus Protocols in Distributed Environment
- Implemented Consensus Protocols and Scheduler with Scala Language

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
- Security System Modeling with Rational Rhapsody 
- Implemented security system with design patterns, Singleton and Factory in Java
- Reverse Engineering Test for Android applications

positions.title: Research in Computer Science with Professor. Jie Gao
positions.description:
- Mobile and Sensor Networks
- Improved Protocol in non-stationary environment

projects.title: Cloud Multimedia Player
projects.description:
- Used Java Media Framework for real-time video and audio streaming
- Implemented in distributed environment and used the Byzantine Consensus protocol for
data integrity and unexpected server crash

projects.title: Implementing Large Scale System
projects.description:
- Used Amazon EC2 and Beanstalk to make distributed environment, and Hadoop in
order to deal with big data files
